ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M1-1,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park Districts and indications as shown on Map No.
226-B in the area bound by:

a line 50 feet north of and parallel to East 112" Street; the alley next east of and parallel
to South Michigan Avenue; East 112" Street; and, South Michigan Avenue

to those of a RS2, Residential Single Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Anthony Beale
Alderman, 9" Ward

Common Address:
11155 S Michigan Avenue
